title: Jude and the Interior
author: Mara Dunmore
blurb: Isandro Brightwater, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
